integrity: Originality is a best-knowledge literature assessment, not a global publication-priority certificate; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the finite simple crown graphs with \(n\ge3\).
No general formula for arbitrary bipartite graphs is claimed.
Finite graph-level checks extend only through \(n=9\); the all-parameter theorem is proved combinatorially.
The forest-number scalar for dense balanced bipartite graphs is prior work, not a new finding.
title: Induced-forest and minimal-feedback-set polynomials of crown graphs
